recipe.name: Ramen Scrambled Eggs
recipe.description: Soft, gently folded scrambled eggs flavoured with instant ramen seasoning toasted in butter. Lovely over rice, on toast or rolled in a tortilla.

ingredients.ingredient_name: Thinly sliced scallions or dried ramen vegetables (for garnish)

steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar and rice vinegar in a medium bowl with a fork until even and slightly frothy.
Set a medium nonstick skillet on medium-low and melt the butter until it foams gently.
Stir the ramen seasoning powder into the butter with a spatula to make a loose paste. Toast for about 30 seconds.
Pour in the eggs and leave them alone for about 2 minutes, until the rim starts to set.
Turn off the burner. Fold the eggs from side to side with a rubber spatula into big soft curds, stopping while they are still a little shiny.
Slide onto plates, top with the scallions or dried ramen vegetables and serve right away. Skip extra salt, as the seasoning is salty already.
You nailed it! Grab a plate and dig in.
